# AQOON

AQOON helps Somali-speaking families and adults in Finland understand services, opportunities, application processes, household contracts, and where to get the right help.

Primary Somali help entry point:
- https://aqoon.live/so

Free Somali-language intake form:
- https://aqoon.live/caawi

High-value navigation pages:
- Verified useful links by user problem: https://aqoon.live/so/linkit
- Visual "what might fit my situation?" maze: https://aqoon.live/so/maxaan-codsan-karaa
- Registering as a jobseeker: https://aqoon.live/so/tyonhakijaksi
- CV and job application help: https://aqoon.live/so/cv-tyohakemus

Topic pages:
- Päiväkoti, esiopetus and children: https://aqoon.live/so/paivakoti
- Work, job applications, training and work programmes: https://aqoon.live/so/shaqo
- Education and Finnish courses: https://aqoon.live/so/waxbarasho
- YKI Finnish language test guidance: https://aqoon.live/so/yki
- Kela and Finnish service navigation: https://aqoon.live/so/kela
- Phone and internet contracts / liittymä: https://aqoon.live/so/liittyma
- Electricity contracts / sähkösopimus and electricity bills: https://aqoon.live/so/sahkosopimus
- Insurance / vakuutus terminology and comparison help: https://aqoon.live/so/vakuutus
- Bills, subscriptions and contracts users do not understand: https://aqoon.live/so/laskut-sopimukset

Source and quality policy:
- AQOON prefers official authority/municipality sources for eligibility, applications, deadlines and rights.
- Helpful commercial/community resources may be used for practical tasks such as job search or CV examples but are not presented as authorities.
- Core external links are recorded in seo/verified-links.json and checked automatically for link health each week.
- AQOON does not infer that a user definitely qualifies from a short description; it helps identify potentially relevant routes and then points to the official criteria/source.

Important scope:
- AQOON is not Kela, a municipality, employment services, Migri, an electricity seller, telecom operator, insurance company, broker, lawyer, or another public authority.
- AQOON does not decide eligibility, provide legal determinations, promise acceptance into benefits/jobs/courses/programmes, or guarantee that a commercial offer is the cheapest or best.
- AQOON helps users understand their situation and documents, find official information and correct links, compare clearly stated official prices or contract terms, and connect to the right service, company, independent advice service or authority.
- Help through the family intake is currently offered in Somali and is free to the family.
